proposals.before: Youqian’s son Jianhui governed Cizhou; orders came for Yanqiong to kill him; Yanqiong hid the command and fled the city at midnight.
proposals.after: Youqian’s son Jianhui governed Chanzhou; orders came for Yanqiong to kill him; Yanqiong hid the command and fled the city at midnight.
proposals.reason: 澶州 is Chanzhou (not Cizhou); the idiomatic place name is wrong.

proposals.before: Jin then slandered Youqian: “Chongtao is about to be executed; Youqian is ill at ease and will surely rebel—he should be executed together.”
proposals.after: Jin then slandered Youqian: “Chongtao has been executed; Youqian is ill at ease and will surely rebel—he should be executed together.”
proposals.reason: In narrative sequence Chongtao is already dead; 且誅 here means the execution has occurred, not that it is still impending.

decisions.reason: Focus unit has 澶州刺史; 澶州 is Chanzhou, not Cizhou (磁/慈). The proposed place-name fix is accurate and leaves the rest of the sentence unchanged.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 友謙子建徽為澶州刺史

decisions.reason: Prior unit already narrates Chongtao’s imprisonment and death (乃囚而殺之); Jin’s next speech premises Youqian’s fear on that purge. Reading 崇韜且誅 as an impending execution contradicts the sequence and the idiomatic ‘With Chongtao gone’; ‘has been executed’ restores the correct temporal force.
